newsitem.title: USA: API shows big fall in U.S. propane, ethane dips.
newsitem.headline: API shows big fall in U.S. propane, ethane dips.

text.p: U.S. stocks of propane took a big fall in the American Petroleum Institute report for November, but ethane, another commodity that has been in short supply, showed only a modest dip.
The API report showed total propane stocks dropped by 3.8 million barrels, from 49.6 million barrels in October to 45.8 million barrels as Nov. 30, 1996.
Traders said the draw in stocks has pretty much been factored into the market, given much earlier Energy Information Administration statistics that showed stocks as of Nov. 30, 1996, at 44.8 million.
